name: curie-lipsync-vendor
description: Install target for the optional rhubarb-lip-sync-wasm aligner. Deliberately OUTSIDE the root package.json and outside the npm workspaces (which are packages/* and apps/*), so that cloning this repo does not force a 37 MB acoustic-model download on anyone who is not running the lip-sync spike. node_modules/ is gitignored at every level, so nothing here is ever committed. Install with: npm install --prefix tools/lipsync/vendor rhubarb-lip-sync-wasm@0.1.8
